name: Nekajui, A Ritz Carlton Reserve
insider_take: This ultra-exclusive Ritz-Carlton Reserve sits on a pristine 1,400-acre peninsula where howler monkeys wake you at dawn and sea turtles nest on your doorstep.
whats_special: Nekajui is one of only nine Ritz-Carlton Reserve properties worldwide, featuring just 15 luxury treehouses and villas suspended in the rainforest canopy. The Peninsula Papagayo is a protected ecological zone where four distinct ecosystems converge - dry tropical forest, mangroves, beaches, and ocean reefs.
pro_tip: Book during green season (May-November) for fewer crowds and incredible wildlife activity, plus you'll witness dramatic afternoon thunderstorms roll across the Pacific from your treetop perch.
dont_miss: The guided nocturnal wildlife walk to spot sleeping sloths and colorful poison dart frogs, and snorkeling at nearby Witch's Rock where volcanic formations create underwater caves teeming with tropical fish.
pros: Ultra-luxury Ritz Carlton Reserve experience with personalized service
Stunning oceanfront location on Peninsula Papagayo
Exclusive access to pristine beaches and tropical landscapes
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects ultra-high-end positioning
Remote Peninsula Papagayo location requires planned transportation
